answer: Seats are tied to water, not keys. Each applicant registers one intake: a tundra catchment well, a basalt aquifer tap, or a coastal line drawing on the ocean. An annual sample is analyzed for stable isotope ratios. Since every source carries its own oxygen-18 and deuterium signature, two thousand wallets sharing one pipe return one identical fingerprint and collapse into a single seat, while a fabricated signature fails the basin map. Attack cost: a real separately plumbed source, licensed sampling, and yearly lab fees.
